b2-29-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Careful Proposal
b2-29-01.scenario: In the Ballhausplatz in Vienna, the foreign minister asks you how to tell the allies politely that they should talk once more.
b2-29-01.prompt: Tell him politely that it would be advisable to talk once more.
b2-29-01.target: Célszerű lenne még egyszer megbeszélni a feltételeket.
b2-29-01.english: It would be advisable to discuss the terms once more.
b2-29-01.canDo: I can use diplomatic conditionals like indokolt volna and célszerű lenne to formulate tactful proposals

b2-29-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Government Aims At
b2-29-02.scenario: Count Abády Balázs asks you what the government is aiming at in the crisis and what it stands by.
b2-29-02.prompt: Tell him what the government aims at and what it has committed itself to.
cues: Say what the government aims at
b2-29-02.target: A kormány a békés megegyezésre törekszik, és elkötelezte magát a béke mellett.
b2-29-02.english: The government aims at a peaceful agreement and has committed itself to peace.
b2-29-02.canDo: I can use törekszik with -ra/-re to say what someone aims at

b2-29-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Concessions and a Red Line
b2-29-03.scenario: The foreign minister asks you what the Hungarian side can offer in the talks and what it can never give up.
b2-29-03.prompt: Tell him what you can concede and what is a red line.
cues: Say what is a red line
b2-29-03.target: Engedményeket tehetünk a vámokban, de a határok védelme vörös vonal.
b2-29-03.english: We can make concessions on customs, but protecting the borders is a red line.
b2-29-03.canDo: I can identify and express non-negotiable boundaries using vörös vonal

b2-29-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Small Country
b2-29-04.scenario: Count Abády Balázs asks you why a small country between great powers cares so much about its sovereignty.
b2-29-04.prompt: Tell him what matters to a small country and why.
cues: Say what matters to a small country
b2-29-04.target: A kis országnak fontos a szuverenitás, mert így maga dönthet.
b2-29-04.english: Sovereignty is important for a small country, because then it can decide for itself.
b2-29-04.canDo: I can say why sovereignty (szuverenitás) matters to a small state

b2-29-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Final Declaration
b2-29-05.scenario: At the end of the talks, the foreign minister asks you what the final declaration should say about the government.
b2-29-05.prompt: Tell him what the government commits itself to in the final declaration.
cues: Say what the government commits itself to
b2-29-05.target: A zárónyilatkozatban a kormány elkötelezte magát a béke mellett.
b2-29-05.english: In the final declaration the government committed itself to peace.
b2-29-05.canDo: I can say what a zárónyilatkozat states, in short sentences

b2-29-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: One Careful Sentence
b2-29-consolidation.scenario: Before the talks end, Count Abády Balázs asks you for one careful sentence he can say to the foreign minister.
b2-29-consolidation.prompt: Give him a polite sentence that offers one more meeting and names a red line.
b2-29-consolidation.target: Indokolt volna még egy találkozó; a határaink védelme viszont vörös vonal.
b2-29-consolidation.english: Another meeting would be justified; the protection of our borders, however, is a red line.
b2-29-consolidation.canDo: I can formulate diplomatic proposals using polite conditionals and hedging (indokolt volna, célszerű lenne)
